targets.rawSql: SELECT database_name, table_name, index_name, avg_fragmentation_pct, page_count FROM sqlserver_monitoring.metrics_index_fragmentation WHERE created_at = (SELECT max(created_at) FROM sqlserver_monitoring.metrics_index_fragmentation) AND avg_fragmentation_pct > 30 ORDER BY avg_fragmentation_pct DESC

SELECT database_name, table_name, equality_columns, inequality_columns, included_columns, avg_user_impact FROM sqlserver_monitoring.metrics_missing_indexes WHERE created_at = (SELECT max(created_at) FROM sqlserver_monitoring.metrics_missing_indexes) ORDER BY avg_user_impact DESC LIMIT 20
